items.title: China braces for Typhoon Dolphin after storm lashes Japan's southern islands
items.description: Typhoon Dolphin has lashed Japan's southern islands of Okinawa and turned towards China, where it is expected to make landfall late Sunday or early Monday local time.

items.title: National Indigenous Music Awards winners, new Hall of Fame inductions revealed
items.description: The National Indigenous Music Awards winners have been announced, with territory talent Baker Boy winning big.

items.title: Todd Blanche confirmed as US attorney general after divisive hearing
items.description: The vote follows a tumultuous confirmation fight that exposed concerns — from some Republicans as well as Democrats — about putting Donald Trump's former defence lawyer in charge of a Justice Department that historically prides itself on its independence from the White House.

items.title: 'Hurt ourselves': Wallabies survive scare as Les Kiss era begins with Japan win
items.description: New Wallabies coach Les Kiss says his side will need to learn how to control their ambitions after Australia hangs on to win a frantic Test match against Japan in the Osaka heat.

items.title: 'Really far inland': Concerns over NSW new bird flu cases in native species
items.description: The New South Wales government has confirmed the state's first cases of H5 avian influenza in Australian native birds.

items.title: Gina Rinehart says ABC Ombudsman finding 'fails all Australian women'
items.description: The mining magnate says the ABC's Editorial Standards need "significant improvement" after a video describing a fictional scenario that involved a violent attack on her was aired on Race Around the World.

items.title: Trump announces $560m critical minerals investment in tiny NSW town
items.description: The Pentagon is investing more than half a billion dollars to expand an Australian critical mineral project poised to become the world's first scandium mine.

items.title: Souths hang on to deny Eels remarkable comeback
items.description: South Sydney concedes 24 unanswered second-half points but manage to hold on for a 28-24 victory, which consolidates the Rabbitohs' place in the league's top eight.

items.title: Tokyo had 13,000 geisha in 1940. That number has plummeted
items.description: Foreign Correspondent secures rare access to the closed world of geisha, Japan's iconic art form struggling to survive.

items.title: Crows get home after almighty Tigers scare in the wet
items.description: Izak Rankine stars as Adelaide manages to get the job done against Richmond in torrential rain at Adelaide Oval.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
